title: Sleepy zebra
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sleepy zebra, side view, standing, eyes closed -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M30 45 Q38 58 30 71' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 42 Q48 58 40 72' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 41 Q60 58 52 73' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 43 Q72 58 64 71' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='33' y='72' width='4' height='6' fill='#4a4a8a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <rect x='33' y='83' width='4' height='6' fill='#4a4a8a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <rect x='61' y='70' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='61' y='72' width='4' height='6' fill='#4a4a8a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <rect x='61' y='83' width='4' height='6' fill='#4a4a8a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <rect x='61' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M22 50 Q14 38 20 26 L30 30 Q28 42 32 52 Z' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <path d='M20 46 Q23 38 26 30' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='22' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='25' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#8a8ab8'/>
  <circle cx='11' cy='25' r='1' fill='#c8c8e8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='12' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='12' rx='1' ry='2.5' fill='#8a8ab8'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='14' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(15 34 14)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='14' rx='1' ry='2.5' fill='#8a8ab8' transform='rotate(15 34 14)'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M22 13 Q18 10 17 15 Q15 12 13 17 Q11 14 10 20' stroke='#5a5aaa' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eye -->
  <path d='M18 21 Q22 24 26 21' stroke='#3d3d6b' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head stripes -->
  <path d='M30 17 Q34 22 31 28' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 18 Q39 22 37 27' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M56 18 L64 18 L56 26 L64 26' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M70 8 L76 8 L70 14 L76 14' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 55 Q84 58 82 68' stroke='#c8c8e8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='69' r='3.5' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
</svg>
